app.name: SeaDuel
app.tagline: Modern Sea Battle. No signup, no ads, no paywalls.

landing.title: Sink the fleet.
landing.subtitle: Fire your first shot in seconds — no account needed.
landing.foundationNotice: Project foundation is in place. The board and rules engine land next.

game.title: Battle against the bot
game.keyboardHint: Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter or Space fires. Press R while placing to rotate.
game.shipsRemaining: {count, plural, =0 {No ships remaining} one {# ship remaining} other {# ships remaining}}
game.shotsFired: {count, plural, =0 {No shots fired} one {# shot fired} other {# shots fired}}

difficulty.label: Bot difficulty
difficulty.easyHint: Fires at random. A gentle warm-up.
difficulty.mediumHint: Hunts in a pattern and finishes off any ship it wounds.
difficulty.hardHint: Works out where your ships must be. Genuinely tough.

placement.instructions: Drag a ship onto the grid, or pick one and tap a square. Tap a placed ship to move it again. Ships may not touch, not even at the corners.

result.wonBody: You sank every enemy ship. Another round?
result.lostBody: The bot sank your fleet first. Try again?
